l.i: inde sublevetis. Condonabitis itaque
uti spero ingenio, pudori, memoriæ, æ-
tati, defuetudini, quicquid quacunque
in re nolens peccavero: si quid forte
inter disputandum aut aliàs exciderit
non mature cogitatum, incongrue
dictum, aut incommode enunciatum; si
dictio aut phrasis non occurrerit rei de
qua agitur exprimendæ satis idonea; si
memoriæ diffisus, (quod me prædico,
& aliàs quoties opus est facturum, et
inter prælegendum constanter,) quæ a-
pud vos dicturus sum e chartis reci-
tavero: si denique quod est ab ante-
cessoribus meis quacunque in re egre-
giè præstitum, id ego vel non præsti-
tero, vel admodum tenuiter.
Hujus autem vestræ in me huma-
nitatis certius mihi pignus dare non
potestis, quàm si præsentis instituti
mei

page.notes: The page ends with the word "mei" alone on the last line, set right-aligned; it is part of the text, not a catchword. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The reading "potestis" is uncertain: the scan may show a mark over the o, which I could not confirm. No other doubtful readings.
